item.title: I had a fall on the uneven roads in Streatham, 8th August
item.description:
Last week Saturday 1st August 2026, I got of 57 bus stop, got off at the make shift stop near Marks Spencer and needed to get the 137 bus so I had to walk from mark's and Spencer to the next available bust stop which was near the Cross road of Telford avenue. As I was walking by I bucked my foot on a uneven pavement that litterally took to the floor, I tried to brace myself but I couldn't stop the fall, I ended face down on the ground, in a lot of pain, two passes by help me up of the ground and I got me to sit up at the bus stop, the bus I want 137 had arrived but I couldn't board because I was in so much pain. I hurt my left knee and arms. This happened around 11.30am. I had called 111 for assist because the pain got worst. They advice me based on what happened and my age and being a diabetic to head over to emergency, I did, had an X-ray and saw a doctor, I have ser severely sprain my left knee and cuts and scraps on armsgiven crutches and pain medication to help me walk and help with the pain and to rest up as much as possible. I have spent the last week barely moving, in pain and having to realy on family for assistance in my home.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Staplefield Close, Streatham Hill, Greater London
